Mises à jour NUR — nouveautés, améliorat: NUR updates — new features, improvements and fixes
Tout ce qui a changé sur la tablette NUR: Everything that has changed on the NUR tablet since its release: new features, improvements and fixes, version by version. Updates arrive by themselves, over Wi-Fi.
NUR s'améliore sans que vous ayez à y pe: NUR gets better without you having to think about it. The tablet checks once a day whether a new version exists and offers to install it. A Wi-Fi connection is all it takes: nothing to plug in, nothing to download on a computer.
Pour voir la vôtre : Réglages → Aide et: To see yours: Settings → Help & tools → About. To look for an update right now: Settings → Help & tools → Check for updates.
Le détail de ce qui change s'affiche sur: The details of what changes are shown on the tablet when it offers you the update. Here, each new feature can be seen on video.
<a href=\"decouvrir.html#v1\"><strong>Le: Arabic letters: eight steps to discover the letters and their sounds, in the voice of a native speaker. A way to get started, a little each day.
<a href=\"decouvrir.html#v3\"><strong>Le: Your country's prayer times: Paris Mosque, Algeria, Tunisia, Morocco, Turkey, Emirates, Indonesia, Malaysia, each on its authority's calendar.
<a href=\"decouvrir.html#v2\"><strong>La: Text size: one setting for the whole tablet, and bigger buttons.
<a href=\"decouvrir.html#v4\"><strong>L': The adhan: all adhans at the same level, with the volume adjustable right where you need it.
Une mise au point sur les langues, trouv: A language fix, found while going through the app with a fine-tooth comb.
<strong>Le Coran en bengali.</strong> L': The Quran in Bengali. The app offered Bengali, but opening a surah in that language showed an error and not a single verse — not even the Arabic text. The Quran opens again, with its recitation and its commentary in Bengali. The translation of the verses, however, is shown in English until a Bengali translation has been added.
<strong>L'aide emploie les mots de l'écr: The help uses the words on the screen. In eight of the eleven languages, it referred to some buttons and sections by terms other than those actually displayed: you could search in vain for the setting mentioned. Thirty-three wordings have been revised.
Les trois modes d'alerte d'une prière an: The three alert modes of a prayer were all announced as "Adhan mode" by the screen reader, whichever mode was chosen.
La grande mise à jour depuis la version: The big update since the version shipped with the tablets. It brings together several months of work: if your tablet was still on 0.5.1, this is everything you receive in one go.
<strong>Six nouveaux recueils de hadiths: Six new hadith collections, bilingual Arabic/French: Sahih al-Bukhari, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Abu Dawud, Sunan Ibn Majah, the 40 Qudsi Hadiths and the 40 Hadiths of ad-Dahlawi. The library now holds nearly 28,700 hadiths, all available offline.
<strong>Deux volumes séparés</strong> :: Two separate volumes: the adhan volume and the Quran recitation volume are adjusted independently. Turning one up no longer affects the other.
<strong>Télécharger tout le Coran en une: Download the whole Quran at once, to listen to it offline. The download resumes by itself if interrupted.
<strong>Les marque-pages portent leur da: Bookmarks carry their date. The list is sorted newest first, and a long press on a line offers to delete it.
<strong>Reprendre sa lecture.</strong> À: Resume your reading. The first time you open the Quran, NUR asks just once whether you prefer to return to where you stopped or go back to the surah index. The choice can still be changed in the settings.
<strong>Un nouvel écran de réglages</str: A new settings screen: five sections down the side — Prayer, Adhan, Reading, Device, Help & tools — each showing its current setting, with the details alongside.
<strong>L'aide de l'application a été en: The app's help has been entirely rewritten, in all eleven languages. It described screens that no longer existed and promised a GPS the tablet doesn't have.
<strong>L'écran ne clignote plus à chaqu: The screen no longer flickers at every scroll. Fast refresh is now the default setting.
<strong>Le mode plein écran tient.</stro: Full-screen mode holds. It no longer switches itself off when you unplug the tablet: it stays on until you touch it, or until the battery reaches 15% — enough to keep the energy needed for the prayers.
<strong>La rotation automatique est désa: Auto-rotation is off by default. On a tablet sitting on a stand, it cost a dozen hours of battery life. It can still be switched on in the settings.
<strong>Lecture du Coran plus confortabl: More comfortable Quran reading: page turns align with the lines, the Arabic line spacing has been reworked, and the verse number no longer takes up a line of its own.
L'assistant de première mise en route a: The first-start assistant has been completely reworked.
<strong>L'adhan, sur son chemin critique: The adhan, on its critical path. An alarm could carry the previous day's time — up to two minutes off, and Fajr sounded twice. A prayer could also stay silent after the clock was reset. Alarms now reschedule themselves after an update, a clock change or a time-zone change.
Quitter les réglages pendant l'adhan cou: Leaving the settings during the adhan cut off the sound.
L'application pouvait s'arrêter au momen: The app could crash when stopping the adhan.
Tant que l'assistant de configuration n': Until the setup assistant is finished, the tablet no longer sounds for a default city.
<strong>En arabe</strong>, le nom de cha: In Arabic, each prayer's name was shown twice and the back arrows pointed the wrong way. Arabic letters came apart from one another on the home screen and in the Quran.
La méthode de calcul recommandée apparai: The recommended calculation method appeared twice in the list, and none was suggested when the app was not in French.
Plus de message « vous avez la dernière: No more "you have the latest version" message when the network is unreachable, and a postponed update is offered again.
La version installée sur les tablettes a: The version installed on the tablets when they were shipped. Adhan reliability fix.
Votre tablette n'a pas encore reçu la mi: Hasn't your tablet received the update yet?
La vérification a lieu une fois par jour: The check happens once a day, and only if the tablet is connected to Wi-Fi. You can trigger it by hand from Settings → Help & tools → Check for updates.
Le téléchargement fait une soixantaine d: The download is around sixty megabytes: leave the tablet connected until it finishes. If something gets stuck, write to us.
